components.name: Selected metric
components.description: Metric control; selection applies to the existing roster.
components.css: .ds-metric-active{font-family:'Ledger Han','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:5px;padding:9px 14px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s,color .18s;background:var(--gold,#d7b878);color:var(--bg,#111416);}.ds-metric-active:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold,#d7b878);outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Available metric
components.description: Metric control; selection applies to the existing roster.
components.css: .ds-metric-idle{font-family:'Ledger Han','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:5px;padding:9px 14px;cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s,color .18s;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#f2ede3);}.ds-metric-idle:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold,#d7b878);outline-offset:5px}.ds-metric-idle:hover{background:var(--hover,#23282b)}

components.name: Sort order
components.html: <label class="ds-order">排序 <select aria-label="排序"><option>从低到高</option><option>从高到低</option><option>查询顺序</option></select></label>
components.css: .ds-order{font-family:'Ledger Han','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted,#afb5b8)}.ds-order select{font-family:'Ledger Han','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;background:var(--surface,#191d20);color:var(--ink,#f2ede3);border:1px solid var(--line,#343a3d);padding:8px 27px 8px 10px;border-radius:5px;min-height:40px}.ds-order select:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold,#d7b878);outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Roster status
components.css: .ds-status{font-family:'Ledger Han','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;font-size:12px;padding:0 5px;border:1px solid #4c5358;color:#c8ced2;border-radius:3px}

components.name: Ranking row
components.description: Interactive ranking row; example amounts are illustrative.
components.css: .ds-row{font-family:'Ledger Han','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;display:grid;grid-template-columns:30px 120px minmax(30px,1fr) 60px;gap:15px;width:100%;min-height:74px;padding:13px 0;text-align:left;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#f2ede3);border:0;border-top:1px solid #292e31;cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s}.ds-row:hover{background:var(--surface,#191d20)}.ds-row:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold,#d7b878);outline-offset:5px}.ds-rank{color:var(--muted,#afb5b8);text-align:center}.ds-rank,.ds-value{font-family:'Ledger Numbers',sans-serif;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-value{font-size:25px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.1;text-align:right}.ds-track{position:relative;height:26px}.ds-track i{position:absolute;top:5px;width:65%;height:16px;border-radius:2px;background:var(--gold,#d7b878)}

components.name: Account total
components.description: Net estimate with persistent unit; example amount is illustrative.
components.css: .ds-total{font-family:'Ledger Han','PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;font-size:14px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--muted,#afb5b8);font-size:12px;margin-top:5px;border-top:1px solid var(--line,#343a3d);padding-top:17px}.ds-total strong{font-family:'Ledger Numbers',sans-serif;font-size:46px;line-height:1.2;font-weight:500;color:var(--gold,#d7b878);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-total span{margin-left:7px}

narrative.overview:
Courtside Ledger presents Chinese NBA salary estimates as a readable financial ledger. Dark graphite, warm white and restrained gold support horizontal ranking bars, aligned amounts and explicit roster status.

The same result drives the chart and table. Embedded Chinese and numeric fonts preserve the presentation offline; labels and calculation assumptions remain visible alongside the amounts.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite surfaces with warm white text and restrained gold emphasis.
Chinese sans-serif labels paired with condensed, tabular financial numerals.
Flat ledger rows, visible status labels and a synchronized data table.
dos: Keep chart and table values, selection scope and ordering consistent.
Keep monetary units, roster status, snapshot dates and settlement assumptions visible.
Embed the bundled fonts and honor reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Do not imply that a metric switch selects a new league-wide roster.
Do not equate retained payments with confirmed retirement.
Do not replace explicit status labels with color alone.
